blurb: Guests sail aboard the Aloha, a 38' Jeanneau Sun Odyssey 389 sailboat, from Hingham/Hull Harbor or Boston Harbor. Offerings include a 3-hour sunset cruise, half-day or full-day private charters, and fully customized experiences for special occasions. The cruises provide a personal, private sailing experience with complimentary non-alcoholic beverages and options for catering and decorations.
